style: soft 3D cartoon, warm colors, cozy lighting, friendly rounded characters, clean simple background, vertical 9:16

characters.Bobo: a small round orange teddy bear with big black eyes and a green backpack
characters.Fern: a small red tree frog wearing a tiny green leaf hat
characters.Pip: a tiny yellow chick with fluffy feathers

shots.image_prompt: Bobo the bear finds one big cookie on a table in a cozy bedroom, smiling
shots.narration: One sunny morning, Bobo the bear found one big, yummy cookie.

shots.image_prompt: Fern the frog peeks through the bedroom window looking hungry
shots.narration: But outside the window, Fern the frog was very, very hungry.

shots.image_prompt: Bobo and Fern share a cookie broken in half, both smiling happily
shots.narration: So Bobo broke the cookie in half. Sharing makes everything taste better!

shots.image_prompt: Bobo the bear holds a big green leaf umbrella on a rainy forest path
shots.narration: It was a rainy day, and Bobo had a big leaf umbrella.

shots.image_prompt: Fern the frog shivering under a small mushroom in the rain
shots.narration: Fern was getting wet under a tiny mushroom.

shots.image_prompt: Bobo and Fern walking together under one leaf umbrella in the rain, happy
shots.narration: Bobo said, come under my umbrella! Now they were both warm and dry.

shots.image_prompt: Pip the chick crying while a red balloon floats up into the sky
shots.narration: Oh no! Pip's red balloon floated away.

shots.image_prompt: Bobo the bear jumping and stretching to reach a high balloon but failing
shots.narration: Bobo jumped and jumped, but he could not reach it.

shots.image_prompt: Fern the frog standing on Bobo's shoulders catching the red balloon, Pip cheering
shots.narration: Then Fern climbed up and caught it. Teamwork saved the day!

shots.image_prompt: Pip the chick awake in a small nest at night under twinkling stars
shots.narration: It was bedtime, but little Pip could not sleep.

shots.image_prompt: Bobo the bear humming softly next to Pip's nest, stars twinkling
shots.narration: Bobo sat close and hummed a soft, sleepy song.

shots.image_prompt: Pip sleeping peacefully while Bobo tiptoes away, moonlight
shots.narration: Soon Pip was fast asleep. Goodnight, little Pip.

shots.image_prompt: Fern the frog splashing happily in a big muddy puddle
shots.narration: Splash! Fern loved jumping in the big muddy puddle.

shots.image_prompt: Bobo the bear covered in mud looking surprised
shots.narration: But the mud splashed all over Bobo!

shots.image_prompt: Bobo and Fern washing in a clear stream, laughing with bubbles
shots.narration: They washed in the stream and laughed together. Fun and clean!

shots.image_prompt: Bobo the bear looking up at a jar of honey on a very tall shelf
shots.narration: Bobo wanted the honey on the tall, tall shelf.

shots.image_prompt: Bobo the bear falling backward after trying to climb, Fern watching
shots.narration: He tried and tried, but he could not reach it.

shots.image_prompt: Bobo and Fern stacked together reaching the honey jar, smiling
shots.narration: Then Bobo asked Fern for help, and together they reached it. Asking for help is smart!

shots.image_prompt: Bobo the bear and Fern the frog looking at a map in a green forest
shots.narration: Bobo and Fern were going to the big meadow.

shots.image_prompt: Bobo and Fern stopped at a wide river looking worried
shots.narration: Uh oh! A wide river blocked their way.

shots.image_prompt: Bobo and Fern crossing the river on a leaf boat, smiling
shots.narration: They did not give up. They built a leaf boat and sailed across!

shots.image_prompt: Pip the chick standing nervously on the edge of a tree branch
shots.narration: Pip stood on the branch. It looked very high.

shots.image_prompt: Bobo the bear and Fern the frog cheering from below, looking up
shots.narration: Bobo and Fern cheered, you can do it, Pip!

shots.image_prompt: Pip the chick flying with tiny wings, leaves swirling like confetti
shots.narration: Flap, flap, flap! Pip flew. Being brave feels wonderful!

shots.image_prompt: Bobo the bear hanging colorful balloons in a treehouse
shots.narration: Bobo had a secret. He was planning a surprise.

shots.image_prompt: Fern the frog arriving at the treehouse door, curious
shots.narration: Fern climbed up, wondering what was going on.

shots.image_prompt: Fern the frog hugging Bobo in front of a birthday cake with a candle
shots.narration: Surprise! Happy birthday, Fern! Fern said thank you with a big hug.

shots.image_prompt: Fern the frog accidentally dropping Bobo's little toy train
shots.narration: Oops! Fern dropped Bobo's toy train, and it broke.

shots.image_prompt: Fern the frog hiding behind a leaf looking sad and guilty
shots.narration: Fern felt sad and hid behind a leaf.

shots.image_prompt: Fern saying sorry to Bobo, then both fixing the toy train together
shots.narration: Then Fern said sorry. Bobo smiled, and they fixed it together. Saying sorry is brave!
